title: llm.ai_settings.changed.v1
description: An owner or admin changed the AI settings of an org (synthwerk#39). It carries the full new state, so a consumer needs no call back. CloudEvents subject and orgid extension: the identity org id. actor: user:<sub> of the owner or admin. No system prompt text: only its length. Identity copies it to the audit list of the org.

version.description: Version of the settings after the change. Goes up by one per change. A consumer drops an event with a version lower than the one it holds.

changed.description: The settings this change set to a new value.

model.description: Default model alias of a new conversation. Never a provider model name.

allowed_models.description: The model aliases the users of the org may pick.

max_input_chars.description: Max characters of one user message.

user_tokens_per_day.description: Token cap per user per UTC day, below the plan. 0: the plan limit only.

system_prompt_chars.description: Length of the system prompt in characters. 0: the service prompt. Never the text.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Absent: the model default.
